landing.title: Compress images without losing control
landing.description: Pixaeron shrinks JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF on our servers — right here, no account required. Sign up when you want higher limits, stored results and a dashboard.
landing.googleData: Use email and password or Google Sign-In. With Google Sign-In, Pixaeron receives your name, email address, and Google account identifier only to create and authenticate your account. Pixaeron does not access Gmail, Google Drive, Google Contacts, or other Google services.
landing.compressorDescription: Files are uploaded to our servers, compressed there, and deleted automatically. Camera and location metadata are stripped from every result.

engine.title: Serious compression engine
engine.description: The same tuned encoders the big services use — mozjpeg for JPEG and palette quantization for PNG — running on our servers, not a stripped-down browser build.

metadata.title: Metadata gone by default
metadata.description: Camera model, GPS position and editing traces are stripped from every result. There is no switch to forget.

noSignup.title: No account needed
noSignup.description: Drop files and download results straight away. An account only raises your limits — it is never a gate.

formats.title: JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF
formats.description: Each format is re-encoded by an encoder tuned for it. The format you upload is the format you get back.

honest.title: Honest results
honest.description: If re-encoding cannot make your file smaller, we say so and return the original — never a padded file or an inflated percentage.

access.title: Your files, briefly
access.description: Uploads live on our servers only as long as your plan keeps them, then they are deleted. Nothing is collected for training or resale.

footer.tagline: Server-side image compression with honest limits.

pricing.title: Plans and pricing
pricing.lead: Every plan compresses with the same engine. Bigger plans keep results longer, allow larger files and skip ahead in the queue.
pricing.note: Paid plans are not on sale yet — pricing is published so there are no surprises.

free.name: Free
free.summary: For everyday compression with an account.

light.name: Light
light.summary: More room and a faster queue.

dashboard.lead: Here is your workspace at a glance.
dashboard.compressDescription: Shrink JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF on our servers.
dashboard.convertDescription: Format conversion is on the way.
dashboard.empty: Nothing here yet — compress your first images.

files.title: My files
files.lead: Recent results, kept for as long as your plan stores them. Oldest results make room for new ones automatically.
